name: For the First Time
source:
Felicity is the CEO of the biggest tech conglomerate in the country. After the news of her husband's disappearance  breaks, she tells you that you need to talk. Felicity then reveals everything she's been holding in. And for the first time, she can be herself.

[From [url=https://thechosengiraffe.itch.io/for-the-first-time]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
费利西蒂是美国最大科技集团的首席执行官。在她丈夫失踪的消息传出后，她告诉你需要谈谈。然后，费莉西蒂揭露了她一直隐藏的一切。这是她第一次可以做自己。

[来自[url=https://thechosengiraffe.itch.io/for-the-first-time]Itch.io[/url]]
